title: Manager Home Experience
notes: Rebuild the signed-in manager homepage around a clear daily operating flow instead of equal-weight dashboard cards.
Add a Start Here priority that surfaces the first urgent or waiting workflow item and links directly to the correct work area.
Add a live dispatch pipeline for jobs needing resources, ready to send, awaiting acknowledgement and active in the field.
Reduce the primary KPI set to the highest-value operational signals while preserving role-based visibility and live Supabase data.
Move today’s jobs ahead of secondary billing and fleet summaries so the daily work is easier to scan.
Increase dashboard text sizes and touch targets to align with the Northborn mobile design system.
Improve mobile layouts for the header, priority action, dispatch pipeline, job rows and quick access links without changing existing permissions or workflow logic.
